name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key. Created by AI under the directions of the maintainer.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.253: The auto-sync fits a subtitle on its DIALOGUE lines only: music and sound labels
    ("♪", "[door slams]", bare capitalised sound words) are dropped from the fit's input and
    re-attached afterwards by time, so each of them still moves with the dialogue around it. They
    used to sit in the cue list as silent voters, where they set the noise estimate, the
    segment-length floor and the block grid: on Line.of.Fire S01E02 that decided between one 6 s step
    (3 s off over four and a half minutes) and the two 3 s steps the plain subtitle shows, and on
    Lioness S02E06 a 12 s block was left standing. Both are gone; seven further files were already
    exact before and stay exact.
